name: LionDallas
description: Compact DS18B20 driver over OneWire for the Lion* stack: discover sensor addresses once and keep them, non-blocking periodic reads, last-good caching with a fault-tolerance window, and the DallasTemperature 4.0.6 power-on-reset / insufficient-power / fault detection. Optional fixed addresses skip the unreliable SearchROM on long buses. DS18B20 family (0x28) only. ESP8266 (reads in a LionTask LionCriticalTask, pumped from loop()) and ESP32 (reads in a dedicated LionRtosTask FreeRTOS task).
keywords: ds18b20, onewire, temperature, dallas, sensor, esp8266, esp32, embedded, arduino
